body_json.prompt: Introduce yourself to the class. What is your name? Where are you from and where do you live now?
body_json.prompt_ar: عرفنا عن حالك بالصف. شو اسمك؟ من وين أنت؟ ووين عايش هلق؟
body_json.example_answer: Hello. My name is Ahmad. I am from Syria. Now, I live in Damascus, Syria. I am twenty-five years old. I am a student.

body_json.prompt: Talk about your family. Do you have brothers or sisters? How many brothers or sisters do you have?
body_json.prompt_ar: احكي عن عيلتك. عندك أخوات شباب أو بنات؟ قديش عدد أخواتك؟
body_json.example_answer: I have a nice family. I have one brother and two sisters. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. We live together.

body_json.prompt: Describe your bedroom in Syria. What is in your room? What color are the walls?
body_json.prompt_ar: اوصف غرفة نومك بألمانيا. شو في بقلب غرفتك؟ وشو لون الحيطان؟
body_json.example_answer: My room is small and clean. It has a white bed. I have a brown desk and a big window. The walls are white.

body_json.prompt: Talk about your morning routine. What time do you wake up? What do you drink or eat every morning?
body_json.prompt_ar: احكي عن روتينك الصباحي. بأي ساعة بتفيق؟ شو بتشرب أو بتاكل كل يوم الصبح؟
body_json.example_answer: Every morning, I wake up at seven o'clock. I drink hot black tea. I eat warm bread with cheese. Then, I go to school.

body_json.prompt: What is your favorite fruit? Do you like red apples or green bananas? Why do you like it?
body_json.prompt_ar: شو هي فاكهتك المفضلة؟ بتحب التفاح الأحمر ولا الموز الأخضر؟ وليش بتحبها؟
body_json.example_answer: My favorite fruit is the red apple. I like red apples because they are very sweet and fresh. I eat one apple every day.

body_json.prompt: Talk about the numbers in your language class. How many students are there? How many men and women do you see?
body_json.prompt_ar: احكي عن الأرقام بصف اللغة تبعك. كم طالب وطالبة فيه؟ كم زلمة ومرّة شايف؟
body_json.example_answer: My class is big. There are ten students in the room. We have four men and six women. We have twelve new books.

body_json.prompt: What is your favorite hobby on the weekend? What do you like to do on Saturday afternoon?
body_json.prompt_ar: شو هي هوايتك المفضلة بعطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟ شو بتحب تعمل يوم السبت بعد الظهر؟
body_json.example_answer: On Saturday afternoon, I do not study at school. I play football with my Syrian friends in the park. Football is my favorite hobby.

body_json.prompt: Talk about your mother. What is her name? What does she look like and where does she live?
body_json.prompt_ar: احكي عن أمك. شو اسمها؟ كيف شكلها ووين عايشة؟
body_json.example_answer: My mother is very kind. Her name is Fatima. She has beautiful green eyes and brown hair. She lives in Damascus, Syria now.

body_json.prompt: Describe the shared kitchen in your flat. Is it big or clean? Do you cook dinner there with your flatmates?
body_json.prompt_ar: اوصف المطبخ المشترك يلي بشقتك. هل هو كبير أو نضيف؟ عم تطبخ عشا هنيك مع رفقاتك بالسكن؟
body_json.example_answer: The kitchen in our flat is clean and big. It has a small table. I cook chicken and rice there every night with my flatmates.

body_json.prompt: Talk about shopping for food. What do you buy at the German supermarket? How much money do you pay?
body_json.prompt_ar: احكي عن شرا الأكل. شو عم تشتري من السوبرماركت الألماني؟ وقديش عم تدفع مصاري؟
body_json.example_answer: I go to the supermarket on Friday. I buy fresh white milk, warm bread, and red tomatoes. The food is cheap. I pay ten euros.
